items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: I have a word, Roman, I fell in love with you.

ctx.x: I wish I did have it here. I think I have it at home.
Yeah, Nancy Dave, I might get better, shake your punch. Yeah, those records, I mean, I have a word, Roman, I fell in love with you.
If I had a little more time, I could have dug them up.
